shortDescription: MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Centerspace's (NYSE:CSR) Board of Trustees has declared a regular quarterly distribution of $0.77 per share/unit, payable on October 14, 2026, to common shareholders and unitholders of record at the close of business on September 29, 2026.About Centerspace…

children: ) Board of Trustees has declared a regular quarterly distribution of $0.77 per share/unit, payable on October 14, 2026, to common shareholders and unitholders of record at the close of business on September 29, 2026.

Centerspace is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. Founded in 1970, as of August 31, 2026, Centerspace owned 47 apartment communities consisting of 10,456 homes located in Colorado, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah.
